item.title: Impact Minerals Advances HPA Commercialisation Through Alluminous-C4V Collaboration
item.description: Impact Minerals (ASX: IPT) has moved to accelerate its high purity alumina (HPA) commercialisation strategy, with its 50%-owned associate company Alluminous entering a technology collaboration agreement with US-based battery innovator Charge CCCV.

item.title: Great Northern Minerals to Expand Catalyst Ridge after Strong Antimony Returns from Rock-Chip Sampling
item.description: Great Northern Minerals (ASX: GNM) has reported a significant antimony discovery at its Catalyst Ridge project after surface sampling identified a quartz–stibnite vein extending for up to one kilometre.

item.title: Weekly wrap: A modest rise to end the week
item.description: The Australian share market enjoyed a modest rise to end the week on Friday after a Wall Street rally caused by optimism of more interest rate cuts in the future. The ASX 200 index closed up 0.5%, or 40 points, to close on 8628.2 points after eight of the 11 sectors rose.

item.title: Viridis Clears Major Hurdle, Unlocking Colossus Rare Earths Future
item.description: Viridis secures COPAM Preliminary License for Colossus, de-risking timeline and targeting 2026 FID; 46% land expansion.

item.title: Invictus Energy set to ramp up Zimbabwe oil and gas hunt
item.description: Invictus Energy to fast-track Cabora Bassa in Zimbabwe after PPSA approval, eyeing Mukuyu's 20 Tcf gas and 845m barrels condensate, plus Musuma-1 upside.

item.title: Mortgage trap in later life: housing debt keeps Australians working longer
item.description: Australians risk retirement as property wealth masks crippling debt: half of 55–64 homeowners owe housing debt; average >$230k, pension gap widening.

item.title: Aureka identifies shallow visible gold in new structure at St Arnaud Comstock
item.description: Aureka (AKA) hits shallow visible gold in a new structure at Comstock, St Arnaud, signaling near-surface resource growth as drilling expands.

item.title: Meteoric's Caldeira Project Secures Key Environmental Green Light
item.description: ASX: MEI — Caldeira LP approved, de-risking Meteoric’s project; LI planned for 2026 as DFS progresses and funding momentum grows.

item.title: EU funding eyes Europe’s first domestic high-purity vanadium producer
item.description: Neometals gains EU funding for VRP; EIT RawMaterials to invest ~$2.7m in Novana Finland vanadium project, targeting Europe’s first high-purity V2O5 producer.

item.title: Mithril Silver and Gold prepares for expanded exploration program at Copalquin project
item.description: Mithril kicks off a 25,000m Copalquin drilling campaign with a third rig, targeting high-grade gold-silver zones as LiDAR and magnetic surveys refine targets.
